name: ielts-master-ai
description: IELTS learning and examination system with event-driven hybrid architecture

scripts.backend:dev: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('backend-core/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo')) fs.unlinkSync('backend-core/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo');" && cd backend-core && npm run start:dev
scripts.ai:dev: node -e "const cp = require('child_process'); const cmd = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'venv\\Scripts\\python' : 'venv/bin/python'; cp.spawn(cmd, ['-m', 'uvicorn', 'app.main:app', '--reload'], { cwd: 'backend-ai', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run backend:dev" "npm run ai:dev" "npm run web:dev"
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && npm run dev:all
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd backend-core && npx prisma migrate dev

author: IELTS Master AI Team
